note: BH-7107: how many full HOLD reads (issue + thread) the reap makes per tick for LIVE machines, so a HOLD comment or a closed issue cancels the in-flight build and releases its slot. Only a GitHub-issue ticket whose open-listing key changed, or that left the open ai-build listing, is read; a cached held verdict costs no read. Reads past the cap are deferred to the next tick and logged. 0 = off: no in-flight hold read, as before.
